fact: Allegedly forcing Car 87 off of the track in Turn 3
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 87 attempted an overtake on the outside on Car 43 into Turn 3, but did not have its front axle ahead of the front axle of Car 43 at the apex as required by the Driving Standards Guidelines. Therefore the Stewards determine that Car 43 was entitled to use the regular racing line without the necessity to leave space for Car 87 on the outside and Car 87 had to concede.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 43 Alleged Forcing Another Driver Off Of The Track
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
